Title.Language: Hymn After Praise of the Three Young Men

Text.Language: God existent before the ages / Sent His chosen angel / To deliver the youths from the furnace / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
الله الأزلى قبل الأدهار / ارسل ملاكه المختار / نجى الفتية من أتون النار / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Nebuchadnezzar the king made a golden image / And told the ministers and all people / When you hear the sound of the trumpet / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
بختنصر الملك أقام صورة من ذهب / وقال للوزراء وكل الشعب / إذا ما سمعتم آلات الطرب / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Immediately come out and fall down / To worship the golden image / Or you will be cast in the furnace / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
تعالوا لوقتكم مسرعين / ولتلك الصورة ساجدين / وإذا لم تسجدوا تلقون فى الآتون / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Then came forth the Chaldeans / And worshipped before the image / Except for the three saintly youths / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
تقدم الكلدانيون / لتلك الصورة خروا ساجدين / ماخلا الثلاثة الفتية القديسين / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
O come Ananias and praise / With the voice of salvation / And praise your God the Messiah / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
تعال إلينا ياأنانياس / ورتل معنا بصوت الخلاص / وسبح إلهك ماسياس / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Men came and informed the king saying / There are three men in the city / Who do not worship the image / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
جاء قوم وأعلموا الملك قائلين / هاهنا ثلاثة رجال ساكنين / لم يسجدوا للصورة بل مهملين / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The king gathered the leaders / The authorities and all ranks / And ordered the furnace to be hotter / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
جمع الملك رؤساء الشعب / وأرباب الدولة وكل الرتب / وقال لهم أوقدوا الأتون بالحطب / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
They bound the hands of the three youths / And cast them in the midst of the furnace / But to them it became as dew not heat / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
أتوا بالفتية موثقين / وطرحوهم فى وسط الأتون / فصار كندى اليسمين / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The angel of the Lord came unto them / And quenched the furnace and strengthened them / And they rejoiced when they saw Him / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
حينئذ ملاك الله جاءهم / أطفأ الأتون وقواهم / وفرحوا به لما أتاهم / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Azarias started to praise and pray / Faithfully without defilement / And gave glory to the power of the Trinity / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
حينئذ صلى عزارياس / صلاة قوية بغيرأدناس / تى اوأوإن إتجوم إن تى اترياس / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Misael likewise proclaimed / With the voice of rejoicing / Bless the Name of Immanuel / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
خاصة بالأكثر ميصائيل / علَّ صوته بالتهليل / اسمو إإ فران إن إممانوئيل / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The king was amazed and surprised / There were only three in the furnace / But now there are four walking freely / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
دهش الملك أيضاً واحتار / أليس ثلاثة ألقوا فى النار / هوذا أربعة يمشون أجهار / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The king truly saw all of them free / Four men walking in the fire / And praising with the voice of rejoicing / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
رأى الملك حقاً اجهار / أربعة رجال يمشون فى النار / ويسبحون ببهجة ووقار / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The king was greatly amazed / And proclaimed saying / “The fourth looks like the Son of God” / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
زاد عجباً ونطق بفاه / هوذا الرابع يشبه ابن الآلهة / فى منظره وفى رؤياه / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Praise our God, O you people / The angels, the thrones and the powers / Praise the Lord God of heaven / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
سبحوه أيها السادات / الملائكة والكراسى والقوات / سبحوا رب السموات / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Praise Him and glorify Him / In the congregations exalt Him / And above all the elders bless Him / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
سبحوه ومجدوه / فى كنائس شعبه ارفعوه / على منابر الشيوخ باركوه / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Praise your God, O Sedrak / Abdenego and the praised Misach / For He saved you from destruction / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
سبح إلهك ياسدراك / وابدناغو والممدوح ميساك / لأنه نجاكم من الهلاك / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Praise Him all you nations / The free, the slaves and the servants / For He saved you from annihilation / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
سبحوه ياجميع الامم / الأحرار والعبيد والخدم / لأنه أنشاكم من العدم / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The fiery furnace, O Ananias / Was quenched by your God the Messiah / O bless His honored Name / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
سعير اللهيب ياأنانياس / أطفأه إلهك ماسياس / إسموا إبيفران توديمياس / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The youths proclaimed with rejoicing / Bless the Lord God of Israel / And remember Him in all generations / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
صاح الفتية بالتهليل / باركوا الرب إله اسرائيل / وإذكروا اسمه من جيل إلى جيل / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
An undefiled sacrifice was offered / O Azarias the praised / Praise the honored Name of God / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
تقدمة قربت بغير أدناس / أيها الممدوح عزارياس / إسمو إإفران توديمياس / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Immanuel quenched the furnace / So rejoice and praise, O Misael / And offer to your God praises / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
أخمد اللهيب عمانوئيل / فسر وسبح ياميصائيل / ورتل لإلهك بالتهليل / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The three youths praised with glory / And proclaimed in a joyful sound / Holy is the beloved Son / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
ظهر الفتية بالتمجيد / ورتلوا بصوت عالى شديد / إفؤاب إبشيرى إم مينريت / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Seven times hotter the fire was lit / And forty-nine full breadths / But the youths did not fear this / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
علا اللهيب فوق الأتون / تسعة وأربعين ذراعاً كاملين / ولم يرهبه المجاهدون / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The three youths overcame / The fiery furnace / And conquered the enemy saying / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
غلب الفتية لهيب النار / وقهروا الاعداء الكفار / فاستحقوا المديح والتذكار / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The king proclaimed in a heard voice / Ananias, Azarias and Misael / The servants of the Most High God / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
فصاح الملك بصوت عال / حنانيا وعزاريا وميصائيل / عبيد الله القوى المتعال / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Come out from the fiery furnace / For your God is powerful / The performer of wonders / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
تعالوا اخرجوا من النار / لأن إلهكم ذو إقتدار / صانع العجائب الكبار / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Honor and glory, O Israel / Offer befor God Immanuel / The sound of rejoicing and praise / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
كرامة ومجداً يا اسرائيل / قدم لإلهك عمانوئيل / تسابيح البركة والتهليل / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Before Him all the nations worship / And all tongues and languages / They praise the Lord of Sabaoth (Powers) / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
له تسجد كل الاسباط / وكل الألسن واللغات / تسبح رب القوات / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
There is no other Lord like You / Who is powerful and feared / Your dominion is eternal / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
من يشبهك يارب الأرباب / إله قوى عزيز مهاب / سلطانك فى كل الأحقاب / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
The furnace became a cool mist / Therefore the youths proclaimed / saying, Praise you the gracious Lord / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
ندى بارد صار الأتون / فصاح الفتية بصوت حنون / إسمو إإبشويس تون كيريون / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Rejoice in the God of Jacob / For He is a powerful and feared God / And praise His Holy Name / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
هللوا لإله يعقوب / وابتهجوا بالله القوى المرهوب / ورتلوا لإسمه المحبوب / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
Praise Him also with hymns / Bless the Lord, O you three youths / Praise the Lord at all times / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
وسبحوه أيضاً بالألحان / باركوا الرب أيها الفتيان / إفهوس إإفنوتى ان سيو نيفين / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
For the Lord our God is greatly praised / And feared above the other gods / By His might He delivered the youths / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
لأنه عظيم ومبارك جدا / ومخوف على كل الآلهة / بقدرته نجى الفتية / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف
To Him are due glory and worship / Before the Creator and feared God / The gracious God, Source of good things / (Hoce Erof Ari-Ho-oo Chasf)
يليق الإكرام والسجود / بالإله الخالق المعبود / رب الأحسان مصدر الجود / هوس إيروف آرى هوؤتشاسف

Title.Language: Another Hymn After Praise of the Three Young Men

Text.Language: Bless the God of Israel / O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael / Who at all times, comforts and heals / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon / conquered Israel, his might was shown / and brought young men to Chaldean / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Azarias, Ananias, and Misael / also the great prophet, Daniel / were brought from the land of Israel / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
To his palace, ordered the king / the young men, his servants will bring / to be raised Chaldeans in everything / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Even the Jewish names had to go / new names on them, they did bestow / Sedrac, Misac, and Abednego / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
They served the king with honesty / their wisdom was the best in the city / their goal was heaven and eternity / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
They wouldn’t eat from the idol’s meat / beans and vegetables only, did they eat / they were healthy, handsome and neat / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The king then made and image of gold / everyone will worship, they were told / to his orders, all nations will hold / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Those who will not worship Him now / will be tormented; to know how / to get down, on their knees and bow / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
All to the king's orders will obey / for the laws of the land, he lays / what people follow, is what he says / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The Chaldeans came and fell down / from every city and every town / to worship the bearer of the crown / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The three young men were strong and bold / our faith in the Lord will not be sold / our religion, we will uphold / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The Chaldeans with them were upset / and said their heads, we sure will get / a lesson that no one will forget / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Unhappy was the king, when he got to know / that Sedrac, Misac and Abednego / to his orders, they all said no / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
He said in the fire, they will be thrown / and everywhere it will be known / that no one disobeys the throne / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Seven times hotter, the fire was lit / no one could survive for one minute / those who threw them, were burned by it. / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The three youths did together pray / that their faith will always stay / willing to die for God that day / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Azarias felt the Lord's hand / will help their body, the pain to stand / they will not stray in a foreign land / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The Fourth that strengthened Ananias / would let the harm of the fire pass / the fire will have no aftermath / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Likewise, also Misael / praised the Lord Immanuel / the body may die, but the soul will heal / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The Angel came and the fire was tame / there was no more power in the flame / the might of nature obeys His Name / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The fiery furnace would not dare / even to touch or burn their hair / God stood by them wherever they were / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The king from what he did was sad / great hopes for the three youths, he had / from what was happening, he was mad / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
In his heart, he wished them well / but how could they in a fiery hell / escape from burning, who can tell / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The king was astonished to see four / instead of three, there were before / and said how come I see one more / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The three were loose, the king could see / the fourth like the Son of God was He / all this he said is strange to me / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
They said our God is greater than all / for He created every body and soul / on His protection, we always call / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The king was happy that the youths were brave / to his orders, they would not cave / their God sent an Angel to save / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The king, for the youths, made a decree / no one with them dare disagree / worshipping their God, they would be free / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Hate for the three youths was halted / worshipping their God was not faulted / the Name of the Lord was exalted / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
As they obeyed and followed the Lord / and did not worship silver or gold / even the hot furnace became cold / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Praise the Lord, all you nations / exalt Him in the congregations / from now and unto all generations / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Praise your God, O Sedrac / Abednego and honored Misac / from all dangers, He brought you back / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
The Chaldeans wanted your eradication / God guarded you from desolation / and saved you from annihilation / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
Let every nation raise their voice / the savior is our only choice / In His glorious wonders, we rejoice / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
We, the Church, admire you so / your courage helps our faith to grow / Sedrac, Misac, and Abednego. / Hwc e~rof a~rihouo~ [acf.
